sentences.text: A vessel or object towed astern shows sidelights and a sternlight, plus a diamond shape by day when the tow is over two hundred meters.
Under International rules, a vessel being pushed ahead shows sidelights at the forward end.
Under Inland rules, she shows sidelights and a special flashing light at the forward end.
The special flashing light is yellow, flashes fifty to seventy times a minute, and shows forward over an arc between one hundred eighty and two hundred twenty-five degrees.
A vessel towed alongside shows a sternlight and, at the forward end, sidelights.
Any number of vessels pushed or towed alongside in a group are lit as one vessel.
